description: This horizontal stacked bar chart illustrates the percentage breakdown of "Matched" and "Not Matched" outcomes across six distinct evaluation categories. The vertical axis contains the categories, listed from bottom to top as Correct, Rigorous, Self-aware, Active, Oriented, and No Hallucination, without an explicit axis label. The horizontal axis represents the value in percentages, featuring a linear scale that ranges from 0% to 100% with tick labels at regular intervals of 20%. Each category is represented by a single horizontal bar divided into two stacked segments that together total 100%. According to the legend positioned in the middle right of the chart, the dark blue segment on the left represents "Matched," and the light blue segment on the right represents "Not Matched." Every bar segment is annotated with its exact percentage value, with "Matched" values in white text and "Not Matched" values in black text. The "Correct" category displays the highest "Matched" value at 99.00% and the lowest "Not Matched" value at 1.00%, whereas the "Self-aware" category displays the lowest "Matched" value at 94.00% and the highest "Not Matched" value at 6.00%. The intermediate categories show "Matched" and "Not Matched" values of 95.33% and 4.67% for Rigorous, 97.00% and 3.00% for Active, and 97.33% and 2.67% for Oriented. On the top bar for "No Hallucination," the "Not Matched" value is annotated as 1.67%, while the annotation for the corresponding "Matched" value is visually obscured by a small grey rectangular artifact. The categories are not sorted in a strict alphabetical or numerical order.
